name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc39): a correction to rc38, which said a table name that comes back as 'Graph+DAC' ('BranchMaint+BranchBAccount' on the Branches screen) is read as the table. It was not. rc38 shortened it to 'BranchBAccount', which is not a table either, so the check after such a write still found no table to read, and the result named one that does not exist. The result now says why and tells you to pass verify_dac and verify_filter to have the write checked; on the Branches screen the table is 'Branch'. The write itself was never affected. rc38's other fixes stand: a publish or validation sent while another is running is reported as refused instead of taking the running one's success as its own, a publish is followed through the website restart it causes, for up to three hours, instead of showing 'in progress' forever, and verifying a write with both a table and a filter keeps the record's key. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
